nodes.label: EPIRB / GMDSS
nodes.rationale: Design reference: auto-activation, 406 MHz, 48h battery; LoRa used as low-cost alternative. Too expensive for small fishermen.

nodes.label: LoRa Mesh Multi-hop
nodes.rationale: Extends range without higher TX power; improves reliability where direct propagation is limited at sea.

nodes.label: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO)
nodes.rationale: Heuristic chosen to place buoys maximizing coverage with minimal node count.

nodes.label: MPU6050 IMU tilt trigger
nodes.rationale: Detects extreme tilt indicating capsizing to auto-activate beacon.

nodes.label: Buoy 9 incident 10 May 2025
nodes.rationale: Real case: SAR arrived ~1h44 after report, >3h total; motivates need.

nodes.label: Wiguna, Ashari, Azrial 2025
nodes.rationale: LoRa P2P at sea only 1.2 km; justifies relay optimization.

nodes.label: Sa'adah et al. 2025
nodes.rationale: PSO gateway placement on 157 buoys Selat Madura: coverage 74.5% manual to 100%.
